name: Theodore Crouse
source:
With a keen intellect and a skeptical nature that define a great detective, Theodore finds it difficult to accept the existence of faeries. 
Yet, he places his trust in his former partner, the Faelogist, to uncover the truth. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369020/Death__Faeology/]Steam[/url]]
